content_of_post_to_answer: Can someone become too successful? What makes someone truly intelligent?
answer: Success can become a trap when it keeps expanding faster than a person's ability to understand themselves. The intelligent person is not the one who can accumulate the most achievements, but the one who can recognize when achievement is serving a purpose and when it is quietly becoming the purpose itself. Real intelligence includes knowing what not to chase, because unlimited success without self-awareness can create a very successful life that feels strangely empty.
